    font: inherit;
}

    font-size: 10px;
    color: #94a3b8;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

    position: relative;

    contain: layout paint;
}

    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: .12;
    background-image:
        linear-gradient(#64748b 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, #64748b 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 40px 40px;
}

.word {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    font-size: clamp(15px, 2.5vw, 20px);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #4ade80;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px #22c55e66;
    pointer-events: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
}

<body>

<div id="app">

    <header>
        <div id="logo">⌨️ Typing Game</div>

        <div id="scoreBox">
            <div id="score">0</div>
            <div id="scoreLabel">SCORE</div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <div id="game"></div>

    <div id="control">
        <div id="inputWrap">
            <input
                id="inputBox"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Gõ từ đang rơi..."
                autocomplete="off"
                autocorrect="off"
                autocapitalize="off"
                spellcheck="false"
                inputmode="text"
            >
        </div>

        <div id="inputHint">
            Gõ chính xác từ xuất hiện trên màn hình để ghi điểm
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

<!-- GAME OVER -->

<div id="gameOverModal" class="modal" hidden>
    <div class="box">
        <div id="modalIcon">💥</div>
        <h2>Game Over!</h2>
        <p>Bạn đã bỏ lỡ một từ.</p>

        <div id="finalScore">0</div>
        <p>Điểm số của bạn</p>

        <button class="b" id="restartBtn">
            🔄 Chơi lại
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<script>

// ========================================
// CONFIG
// ========================================

const wordsList = [
    "html","css","javascript","game","code","win","play","fun","typing","fast",
    "slow","quick","speed","keyboard","mouse","screen","browser","window","input","output",
    "click","press","enter","space","shift","control","alt","escape","delete","insert",
    "function","variable","constant","object","array","string","number","boolean","null","undefined",
    "loop","condition","switch","case","break","continue","return","async","await","promise",
    "random","shuffle","select","filter","map","reduce","sort","search","find","replace",
    "create","update","delete","render","display","layout","design","style","color","theme",
    "button","modal","popup","overlay","animation","transition","transform","rotate","scale","translate",
    "responsive","adaptive","mobile","desktop","tablet","resolution","viewport","dimension","pixel","ratio",
    "performance","optimization","efficiency","memory","storage","database","server","client","network","protocol",
    "security","encryption","authentication","authorization","session","cookie","token","firewall","privacy","protection",
    "challenge","difficulty","strategy","solution","algorithm","complexity","recursive","iteration","calculation","evaluation",
    "understanding","knowledge","experience","improvement","development","programming","engineering","architecture","framework","library"
];

// ========================================
// ELEMENTS
// ========================================

const game = document.getElementById("game");
const input = document.getElementById("inputBox");
const scoreText = document.getElementById("score");
const modal = document.getElementById("gameOverModal");
const finalScore = document.getElementById("finalScore");
const restartBtn = document.getElementById("restartBtn");

// ========================================
// GAME STATE
// ========================================

let words = [];
let score = 0;
let gameOver = false;

// ========================================
// RESPONSIVE
// ========================================

function getMaxWords() {
    const width = game.clientWidth;
    const height = game.clientHeight;

    const perRow = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 120));
    const rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 40));

    return Math.max(1, Math.floor(perRow * rows * 0.6));
}

// ========================================
// SPAWN WORD
// ========================================

function spawnWord() {

    if (gameOver) return;

    if (words.length >= getMaxWords()) return;

    const text = wordsList[
        Math.floor(Math.random() * wordsList.length)
    ];

    const el = document.createElement("div");

    el.className = "word";
    el.textContent = text;

    game.appendChild(el);

    const wordWidth = el.offsetWidth;
    const maxX = Math.max(0, game.clientWidth - wordWidth);

    let x = Math.random() * maxX;

    // Tránh sinh chữ quá gần nhau.

    let safe = false;
    let tries = 0;

    while (!safe && tries < 20) {

        safe = true;

        for (const w of words) {

            const dx = Math.abs(w.x - x);
            const dy = Math.abs(w.y);

            if (dx < Math.max(100, wordWidth) && dy < 30) {

                safe = false;
                x = Math.random() * maxX;

                break;
            }
        }

        tries++;
    }

    el.style.left = x + "px";
    el.style.top = "0px";

    words.push({
        el: el,
        text: text,
        x: x,
        y: 0
    });
}

// ========================================
// UPDATE GAME
// ========================================

function update() {

    if (gameOver) return;

    for (const w of words) {

        w.y += 1.5;

        w.el.style.top = w.y + "px";

        // Chữ vượt khỏi vùng chơi = Game Over.

        if (w.y + w.el.offsetHeight > game.clientHeight) {

            endGame();
            return;
        }
    }
}

// ========================================
// CHECK INPUT
// ========================================

function checkInput() {

    if (gameOver) return;

    const val = input.value.trim();

    if (!val) return;

    const index = words.findIndex(w => w.text === val);

    if (index === -1) return;

    // Xóa từ đã nhập đúng.

    words[index].el.remove();

    words.splice(index, 1);

    score++;

    scoreText.textContent = score;

    input.value = "";
}

// ========================================
// ANTI COPY / PASTE
// ========================================

// Chặn copy, cut, paste và kéo thả.

document.addEventListener("copy", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
});

document.addEventListener("cut", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
});

document.addEventListener("paste", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
});

document.addEventListener("drop", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
});

// Chặn menu chuột phải.

document.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
});

// Phòng trường hợp trình duyệt hỗ trợ beforeinput.

input.addEventListener("beforeinput", e => {

    if (e.inputType === "insertFromPaste" ||
        e.inputType === "insertFromDrop" ||
        e.inputType === "insertFromYank") {

        e.preventDefault();
    }
});

// Chỉ xử lý khi người chơi thực sự nhập liệu.

input.addEventListener("input", checkInput);

// ========================================
// GAME OVER
// ========================================

function endGame() {

    if (gameOver) return;

    gameOver = true;

    finalScore.textContent = score;

    modal.hidden = false;

    input.blur();
}

// ========================================
// RESTART GAME
// ========================================

function restartGame() {

    // Reset trạng thái.

    gameOver = false;
    score = 0;
    words = [];

    // Reset giao diện.

    scoreText.textContent = "0";
    input.value = "";

    modal.hidden = true;

    // Xóa toàn bộ chữ cũ.

    game.replaceChildren();

    // Trả quyền nhập liệu.

    input.focus();
}

// ========================================
// EVENTS
// ========================================

restartBtn.addEventListener("click", restartGame);

// Giữ focus khi người chơi đang chơi trên desktop.
// Không tự bật bàn phím ảo trên mobile.

input.addEventListener("blur", () => {

    if (gameOver) return;

    if (window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) {

        setTimeout(() => {

            if (!gameOver) input.focus();

        }, 100);
    }
});

// ========================================
// CLEANUP SOMEe / OVERLAY
// ========================================

setInterval(function () {

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(el => el.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "div[style='height: 65px;']"
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

}, 10);

// ========================================
// START GAME
// ========================================

setInterval(spawnWord, 2000);

setInterval(update, 30);

</script>

</body>
</html>
